MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Word Classes ● Demonstrative pronouns 这 and 那 as attributives ● Ad.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Word Classes ● Demonstrative pronouns 这 and 那 as attributives ● Ad.
